limitations: These are test specifications, not executable product drivers or observed product results.
The typed public multi-selection interface must be accepted; fields and error mapping remain a candidate.
Unsupported later-stage functions must not be represented as successful and existing host features must not be suppressed.
MSE-20/23/26 and D07 protobuf/Abseil OOM remain separate incomplete findings.
